bosses.name: Olga
bosses.strategy:
Olga will use normal attacks, Blaze, Rock Storm, Nova, Icy Breath, and
Lightning to do decent damage each round, maybe 50-60 HP of damage every
round. Watch out if she uses Mind Assault to steal your MP, as you'll
want to recover it immediately if she takes too much.

Cast Blessed Light rounds one and two, then Cure the next if needed.
Blessed Light two rounds, Cure the third. Lather, rinse, repeat. Oh, and
don't forget to recover your SP if needed. Not much else you can do since
it's just Alice.

Make sure to Save and use a Tent, if needed, at the Save Point near the bar.
When you're ready, enter the bar and approach the owner. Watch the scene, and
you'll eventually gain control of Alice.

As Alice, enter the women's restroom, then check both stalls and the mirror.
Repeat this again, and then a third time to trigger a battle with Olga.

After the battle, watch the scene, then you'll regain control. As Yuri, go into
the men's bathroom and check the top of the room. You should find a
[_LOTTERY TICKET_] on the floor.

That's it for Prague, so head on out to the World Map. We're heading to Rouen
next.
